limits: The code snapshot was read, not executed. Its exact match to the historical live deployment was not independently verified.
Project says 1% creator tax and GOOGL pairing for FLYBRAIN; these fields were not independently decoded from the receipt in this review.
Older TEST deployments in README have different addresses, wallet and 2% creator tax; do not confuse them with FLYBRAIN.
Direct RPC/REST returned HTTP 403 through the shell route; contract and transaction were verified through normal public Blockscout UI.
Successful Pons launch does not establish our operator eligibility or NVDA acceptance.

conclusion: Fly-brain token narratives and a real Pons V2 token deployment now verified. Do not market BELLFLY as novel merely because a fly launches a token. A precommitted neural LAUNCH/NO_LAUNCH gate remains a design objective to compare rigorously, not a proven unique market gap. Re-evaluate Pons integration alongside Bankr using the concrete verified factory.
